purpose: Archaeology training-gap archaeology for Equilibrium: Ring of Kayazu full acquisition chain at Moonrise (Havenhythe), dig-site→region map completeness, ironman/league high-value training methods that are under-represented in planner training data, and multi-dig-site relic region combos. No invented XP/hour figures.

methods.method: Ironman priority stack: mysteries → first-time collections → special research → highest-level hotspot
notes: Ironman Mode/Guide/Archaeology: prioritise mysteries you can complete, then first-time collections, then special research, then excavate the highest-level hotspots available.
Materials lag artefacts: accumulate damaged artefacts first; material caches are catch-up only (no passive artefacts).
Prioritising mysteries keeps you on a site longer so excavation yields more passive materials.
methods.xp_rate_note: Wiki does not publish a single XP/h for this stack; rates depend on level, hotspot, and restoration throughput.

methods.method: Best available excavation hotspot (only when no mysteries/collections are ready)
notes: Ironman guide: train using the best available excavation hotspot only if no mysteries/collections are available to complete.

methods.method: Repeat Green Gobbo Goodies I collections
notes: Ironman guide recommends completing 46 Green Gobbo Goodies I collections in this band.
Warforge artefacts; collector turn-ins at Goblin Village (Asgarnia) per existing planner mapping.

methods.method: Repeat Armadylean I collections for Howl's workshop blueprint fragments
notes: Ironman guide: complete 7 Armadylean I collections to obtain enough torn blueprint fragments (Howl's workshop) to unlock all Ancient Invention blueprints.
Stormguard artefacts; Lowse collector at Armadyl's Tower (Asgarnia).

methods.method: Repeat Red Rum Relics I collections
notes: Ironman guide recommends completing 100 Red Rum Relics I collections across 83-99.

methods.method: Bank artefacts from Orcus altar for Zarosian III / Museum - Zarosian III
notes: Ironman guide: prepare 70-90 sets of artefacts from Orcus altar hotspots for Museum - Zarosian III or Zarosian III.
Orcus altar is at Kharid-et (Desert).

methods.method: Bank artefacts from Armarium debris for Zarosian III / Museum - Zarosian III
notes: Ironman guide: prepare 70-90 sets from Armarium debris.

methods.method: Bank artefacts from Culinarum debris for Zarosian III / Museum - Zarosian III
notes: Ironman guide: prepare 70-90 sets from Culinarum debris.

methods.method: Complete Zarosian III / Museum - Zarosian III via Ancient magick munitions (Inquisitor staff side-loot)
notes: Ironman guide: complete 70-90 Museum - Zarosian III or Zarosian III collections by excavating Ancient magick munitions.

Museum - Zarosian III rewards 16,744 chronotes per completion; Zarosian III rewards 14,884 chronotes and 100 pylon batteries (guide footnote also cites 53k Archaeology XP from the batteries path — not treated here as a hotspot XP/h rate).
Ancient magick munitions also have a chance to drop Inquisitor staff pieces.

methods.method: Praetorian remains for higher Inquisitor staff piece chance
notes: Ironman guide: excavate Praetorian remains for a higher chance of Inquisitor staff pieces.

methods.method: Bandos's sanctum debris for Spear of Annihilation tip, then return to Praetorian remains
notes: Ironman guide: excavate Bandos's sanctum debris for the Spear of Annihilation tip; once obtained, return to Praetorian remains.

methods.method: War table debris for highest Inquisitor staff piece chance
notes: Ironman guide: excavate War table debris for the highest chance of Inquisitor staff pieces.

methods.method: Moonrise Dig Site hotspots + Guthixian I/II collections (missing from ironman guide training table)
notes: Released 15 June 2026. Level 52 Archaeology + Secrets of Amberfell; speak to Utu before hotspots.

Hotspots (XP per material listed on site page, not XP/h): Lunar wheel debris 52 (17.2), Arbour rubble 59 (18.4), Weaver's hut debris 66 (23.4), Shrine debris 75 (30.9), Cauldron debris 82 (39.3), Blood altar 88 (49.4).
Guthixian I (66, Artiefax) first-time reward: Guardian's tear → Hungry Like the Wolf relic path.
Guthixian II (88) includes Fang of Kayazu for Ring of Kayazu.
Ironman Mode/Guide/Archaeology mystery/collection/training tables still omit Moonrise entirely as of this snapshot — high-value gap for ironman/league.
The Beast Within (75): 8,333.3 XP, 246 chronotes, starts at human remains outside Moonrise Temple; rewards Offering bowl (damaged).
Bloodwine, Sweat and Tears (82): 11,110.6 XP, 273 chronotes, broken cauldron in temple; rewards Bloodwine (damaged).
An Unceremonious End (88): 14,444 XP, 293 chronotes, dead colossus in temple; rewards Bloodletting dagger (damaged).
Ironman guide lists special research as priority #3 but does not enumerate Moonrise research rows.

methods.method: Daemonheim Dig Site excavation + Dragonkin V–VII (missing from ironman guide mystery table)
notes: Requires 73 Archaeology and Skaldrun unlocked. Wiki Equilibrium League region badge: Wilderness.
Depths excavation site needs research On the Threshold of the Mind + restored 'friendship bracelet' on toolbelt.
Collections: Dragonkin V (77), Dragonkin VI (87, Pastkeeper's tapestry / Spirit Weaver), Dragonkin VII (113).
Mysteries A New Home / A New Form / A New Age are absent from Ironman Mode/Guide/Archaeology mystery order table.

methods.method: Tetracompass pieces → powered tetracompass → ancient caskets (complete tomes)
notes: Archaeology skill page: tetracompass pieces from excavating or guaranteed from certain collection turn-ins; powered compass leads to ancient caskets with complete tomes as strong secondary XP.
Not framed as a primary training method in the ironman guide but is a high-value ironman XP sink/source once chronotes collections are online.
